decision: PASS for affected-only EN-P1 resolution. The supplied no-resize crop shows introductory gas-mixture, partial-pressure and humidity-unit prose in the original saved whole image's last 844 pixels, not the expected worked-example ending. The separately supplied fresh 390x844 ending viewport of the same hash-bound unchanged display HTML visibly reaches delta V approximately -0.3 m^3, the negative-sign/volume-decrease explanation, and the constant-temperature, no-total-mass-loss and ideal-gas conditions without a restarted title or introduction. The fresh bounded image is sufficient replacement evidence for the specific ending gap; the original whole capture and original first-eight REVISE remain unmodified and are not retroactively passed.

observations.scope: Actual supplied original-whole lower 844px crop, viewed once at 390x844.
observations.assessment: The crop starts with a partial line ending in 'pressure.' It then shows the simplifying dilute-gas-mixture model, imagined removal of other gases at the same temperature and volume, the definition of water vapor partial pressure, humidity pressure units, pascals and millimeters of mercury. A separator and the start of 'Knowing water vapor pressure alone does not show how close the vapor is to...' appear at the bottom. This is early explanatory material, not the closing second-example calculation. No delta V result, final volume-decrease conclusion, or concluding no-mass-loss/ideal-gas condition paragraph appears.
observations.titleObservation: No title or breadcrumb is visible inside this specific crop. The original tiny-preview title-restart observation is retained as history, not independently reasserted from this crop.
observations.limit: Only the parent's existing crop was opened. The original 390x18455 image was not opened, read, resized or recropped.

observations.scope: Supplied fresh ending viewport of unchanged display HTML, viewed once at 390x844.
observations.assessment: After a clipped continuation line at the top, the viewport shows the final vapor-volume estimate of twenty-two hundredths of a cubic meter, subtraction of starting volume, and the explanation that the result is negative because final volume is smaller. The corrected saturation-pressure/textbook ideal-gas rounding paragraph is followed by the distinct equation delta V approximately -0.3 m^3 with visible negative sign and cubic-meter superscript. The next paragraph limits the result to textbook model precision, not an exact real-vapor change under every condition. The final paragraph says the negative sign means a volume decrease by 0.3 m^3 and explicitly assumes constant temperature, no loss of total mass, and the stated ideal-gas approximation for the vapor. The last sentence is fully visible above bottom whitespace. No restarted title, breadcrumb or introductory partial-pressure block appears.
observations.readability: The selected result and condition paragraphs wrap within visible side margins. No blocking horizontal clipping, equation collision or final-sentence truncation is observed. Top continuation clipping is an ordinary scrolled viewport boundary, not a missing-ending defect.
observations.limit: Visual acceptance is limited to these ending paragraphs and this saved headless viewport, not every lesson glyph, every paragraph, all figure labels, or headed application behavior.

This supports treating EN-P1 as a failed original saved-capture evidence artifact rather than asserting a lesson-content or duplicate-heading defect.
